metrics: Deduplicate by document; Recall@5/@20 and MRR@10 on answerable cases; evidence-in-context and no-context on unsupported cases are proxies only, not factual answer/correct-refusal scores.
freezeOrder: Write calibration baseline first, freeze these predeclared candidate acceptance targets with its hash, then run heldout. Do not tune production thresholds using heldout or relax failed targets.
remote: not_run unless caller explicitly invokes run-remote.mjs --split calibration|heldout --run with provider environment. No Keychain.
